title: fix: mark an AI judgement unrateable when the model's answer is not JSON

files.patch:
@@ -58,13 +58,18 @@ def envelope user_prompt, system_prompt
       { path: path, headers: headers, body: body_for(user_prompt, system_prompt) }
     end
 
+    # Bad model output raises a RuntimeError, which LlmService#perform_safe_judgement
+    # turns into an unrateable judgement instead of aborting the run.
     def extract_judgement response_body
       parsed_content = JSON.parse(content_from(response_body))
+      raise TypeError, 'not a JSON object' unless parsed_content.is_a?(Hash)
 
       {
         explanation: parsed_content['explanation'],
         judgment:    parsed_content['judgment'],
       }
+    rescue JSON::ParserError, TypeError => e
+      raise "LLM response was not a JSON judgement (#{e.class}: #{e.message.truncate(80)})"
     end
 
     def user_prompt query_doc_pair

@@ -102,6 +102,21 @@ class LlmServiceTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
       assert_nil judgement.rating
     end
 
+    test 'an answer that is not JSON marks the judgement unrateable instead of raising' do
+      [ 'I am sorry, I cannot rate that document.', '{"judgment": 2, "expla', nil ].each do |content|
+        judgement = Judgement.new(query_doc_pair: query_doc_pair, user: judge)
+
+        stub_request(:post, 'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions')
+          .with(headers: { 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{OPENAI_VALID_KEY}" })
+          .to_return(status: 200, body: { choices: [ { message: { content: content } } ] }.to_json, headers: {})
+
+        service.perform_safe_judgement judgement
+
+        assert judgement.unrateable, "expected #{content.inspect} to be unrateable"
+        assert_match(/\ABOOM: Runtime Error: LLM response was not a JSON judgement/, judgement.explanation)
+      end
+    end
+
     test 'a numeric-looking string judgment value is still accepted' do
       judgement = Judgement.new(query_doc_pair: query_doc_pair, user: judge)
